title: Glimpse of Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan with FREE Tufandag Cable Car Tickets
highlights: Ride the cable car to Kok-Tobe Hill, and explore attractions like a zoo, amusement park, and a monument to The Beatles.
Visit Republic Square in Almaty, surrounded by impressive monuments that tell the story of Kazakhstan's heritage and modern history.
Wander through Baku's Old City, a UNESCO World Heritage site with rich history, iconic mosques, and the famed Maiden Tower.
Relax by the serene waters of Nohur Lake, situated in the mountains of Gabala, a perfect escape for picnicking and boating.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Welcome to Almaty – City of thousand colors! After your arrival at the Almaty International Airport, you will be driven to your pre-booked hotel. Post check-in you can relax at the hotel or head out to explore the city at your own pace. Visit the Zelyony Bazaar, Abai Square and more such places to explore the local culture, cuisine and crafts. Later, you will return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty City Tour
days.desc: Today, you will be driven to Panfilov Park, a beautiful park with lush landscapes and visit the iconic Zenkov Cathedral, admiring its unique wood architecture. In the afternoon, you will head to the Republic Square, enjoying the view of the Independence Monument and a beautiful sunset in the backdrop. After the city tour, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink and Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: In the morning, you will board your transfer to Medeu, and feel the adrenaline rush of skating at one of the largest alpine rinks in the world. Next, you will ascend the Shymbulak Ski Resort via a scenic cable car ride. Located at about 2,200 meters above sea level, the view from Shymbulak includes snow-capped peaks and lush valleys. Later, you will be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort

days.title: Day Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: You will board your transfer to the iconic Green Bazaar, where you can shop for souvenirs, clothes & local snacks to take back home with you. Next, you will be visiting the Rahat Chocolate Factory, where you'll learn about the process of chocolate making and get to take some of the sweets with you. Next, enjoy a cable car ride to Kok Tobe Park, to enjoy various amusement rides & panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Afterwards, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty

days.title: Transfer to Baku from Almaty
days.desc: Post check-out, you will be driven to the Almaty airport for your flight to Baku, Azerbaijan. Upon landing at Heydar Aliyev International Airport, you will be driven to your hotel. After checking in and relaxing for a bit, you can head out to explore the city at your own pace. Visit the iconic Baku eye or head to the Baku Boulevard which is also known as Deniz Kenari Milli Park. Later, you will return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Baku Old City Tour
days.desc: In the morning, you will get driven for a Baku old city tour, and visiting the UNESCO-listed Maiden Tower and the Palace of the Shirvanshahs. Your tour will continue with your visit to the National Carpet Museum, followed by a ride on the funicular. Enjoy a stroll through Little Venice, the Boulevard, and learn about the history of Azerbaijan at the famous National History Museum. Afterwards, you will get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain
days.desc: Board your transfer to Gabala for a day tour, starting with the scenic Nohur Lake. You can enjoy boating (at extra expense) or simply relax by the lake shore before continuing your tour. Next, ascend to Tufandag via the world's longest cable car, and enjoy the beautiful mountain views. Continue your day at Gabalaland, a fun theme park, with exciting attractions like karting and an ice rink. Afterwards, you'll be driven back to the hotel in Baku for overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Gabala and Tufandag Mountain from Baku

days.title: Absheron Peninsula Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to the Absheron Peninsula, where you will admire the natural wonder of Yanardag, known as the Burning Mountain. You will also visit the ancient Zoroastrian temple of Ateshgah and explore the historical Mardakan Castle. Conclude your day tour with a visit to the Heydar Aliyev Center, before getting driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out, you will be driven to Heydar Aliyev International Airport for your return flight home. Bid farewell with fond memories from this tour.
